entities.summary: Bronisław Bohaterewicz (Bohatyrewicz) of the Ostoja coat of arms was a Polish military commander and a general of the Polish Army. Murdered during the Katyn massacre, Bohaterewicz was one of the Generals whose bodies were identified by forensic scientists of the Katyn Commission during the 1943 exhumation.

entities.summary: Bronisław Bohaterewicz (Bohatyrewicz) of the Ostoja coat of arms was a Polish military commander and a general of the Polish Army. Murdered during the Katyn massacre, Bohaterewicz was one of the Generals whose bodies were identified by forensic scientists of the Katyn Commission during the 1943 exhumation.
